en.title: Find Doubles
en.description:
You are given a list of integers. For each element x in the list, if exactly one element in the list equals 2x, include this x in the answer; the answer keeps repeated occurrences of x from the input and is output in ascending order. Twice 0 is still 0.

The input/output protocol and the limits marked as 'added by this site' were compiled by this site; limits not given in the original problem are not treated as part of the original source.
en.input: The first line contains n; the second line contains n integers. The original upper limits are kept in full: 0≤n≤100000, 0≤value≤1000. The original problem gives no positive lower bound on the length, so this site explicitly allows the empty list n=0.
en.output: Output all matching elements in ascending order, separated by spaces; if the answer is empty, output an empty line.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm idea, proof of correctness, and complexity.
